nom: Evre Skincare Time To Shine Raspberry & Almond Scrub for Teens

avis.texte: I like the idea behind this scrub because it uses jojoba beads, raspberry seed, and sweet almond oil instead of the really rough, scratchy particles you sometimes get in facial scrubs. The texture gives you that satisfying physical exfoliation, but it feels much more appropriate for facial skin. The raspberry-almond scent is also nice and makes it feel a little more fun. After rinsing, my skin feels smoother and softer rather than completely stripped. I appreciate the oils in the formula. Sweet almond oil and raspberry seed oil help keep this from feeling like one of those old-school acne scrubs that leaves your face tight and squeaky afterward. One thing I’d keep in mind: this is still a physical exfoliant, even though it’s marketed for sensitive skin. I wouldn’t scrub aggressively or use it every single day, especially if you already use retinoids, exfoliating acids, or other acne treatments. A gentle hand is plenty. The packaging is adorable too, and the 3.4 oz tube is a nice size. Overall, a cute, gentle-feeling scrub for when you want a little extra smoothing without going nuclear on your skin. The jojoba beads are the part I like most.

avis.texte: Love the smell and feel of this scrub! It doesn’t irritate or burn sensitive skin!

avis.titre: Evre Face Scrub: A teen scrub for the young and the young at heart
avis.texte: I ordered the Evre Time To Shine Raspberry & Almond Teen Face Scrub even though my teenage years are more than three score years behind me. The teen label gave me pause, but the promise of gentle exfoliation won me over. K-beauty products have shaped my skincare routine, especially their emphasis on gentle formulas and thoughtfully layered care, so I approached this scrub with an embedded standard in mind. The first thing I noticed about the Evre scrub was its texture. The smooth, spherical jojoba seed beads felt larger than the grain-based exfoliants in my Temi Temi facial cleanser and the rice-based particles in my SKINFOOD scrub foam, yet they moved across my face with a softer touch. I massaged the creamy scrub over my damp face and found that it glided instead of dragging. When I rinsed it away, my face felt immediately smoother, and I did not experience the tightness or irritation that can sometimes follow a more aggressive scrub. The Evre scrub has a gentle raspberry scent that made cleaning my face feel a little more playful; however, the scent faded quickly and disappeared beneath my moisturizer. The playful decoration inside the package made the unboxing feel more thoughtful than I expected. The cheerful presentation gave the scrub the finished look of a gift rather than an ordinary skincare purchase. The thin foil seal over the tube opening reassured me that the product had arrived untouched. Squeezing a small amount from the tube revealed a creamier, lighter consi

This is a gentle face scrub that you would use after a cleanse but before the mist/treatment stage. The squeeze tube expelled a creamy light that contains small beads. The beads rolled smoothly over my skin, in contrast to the more sandy and gritty feel of other scrubs. Hence, the phrase, "gentle" face scrub. The scrub washed off easily using just water and afterwards my skin felt slightly cleaner. I say slightly because, again, this is a gentle scrub. I feel it doesn't remove nearly as much dead skin as another scrub might. On the other hand, this is targeted towards a younger crowd, where removal of dead skin isn't a real concern. As such, this is a good product for a younger person.

I really enjoy this face scrub. The texture is creamy and lightweight with smooth jojoba beads that provide noticeable physical exfoliation without feeling harsh or scratchy. The beads glide easily over damp skin rather than dragging, and I only need a small amount to cover my face. After rinsing, my skin feels clean, smooth, and soft without that tight, stripped feeling I get from some stronger scrubs. I also really like the raspberry and almond scent. It is sweet and pleasant without being overpowering, and the fragrance doesn't linger for very long. I like that the formula includes ingredients such as jojoba, raspberry, and sweet almond oils, which help give the scrub a more moisturizing feel. The 3.4-ounce tube is a good size, and the packaging is cute and nicely presented. My one hesitation is the price. For a fairly simple facial scrub, it feels expensive compared with similar products. I also wouldn't expect this to provide the same level of exfoliation as a more aggressive scrub, so I think of it more as a gentle smoothing treatment than a deep pore-cleansing product. Since it is still a physical exfoliant, I would use a light touch rather than scrubbing aggressively. Overall, I think this is a nice option when I want gentle exfoliation and softer, smoother skin without feeling like I've overdone it. avis.titre: Works great on oily adult skinWorks great on oily adult skin
avis.texte: I originally bought the Evre Time To Shine Raspberry and Almond Teen Face Scrub for my teenager but ended up keeping it for myself. Even though it is marketed for younger people, it works amazingly well on my adult oily skin. The scrub uses jojoba beads and raspberry seeds for physical exfoliation, which feels super gentle and never tears at my skin. Plus, it smells absolutely incredible without relying on any synthetic fragrances. I really appreciate knowing that the formula is completely natural and made without harsh ingredients like parabens or sulfates. After using it a few times a week, my complexion looks significantly brighter and feels incredibly smooth thanks to the natural fruit enzymes. It clears out my oily pores perfectly without leaving my face feeling stripped or tight because the sweet almond oil adds just the right amount of moisture. As an added bonus, the brand uses recycled plastic packaging and donates a portion of their sales to youth mental health charities. It is a fantastic conscious beauty product that I will absolutely buy again.

I have been more serious about my skin's health the last couple of years and while I am now preferring to use actives and ingredients that are not common, they usually come from luxury skincare products. Once in a while I go back to more basic and simple products as long as it is up to par and from a reliable brand. This is why I ordered this. MY EXPERIENCE WITH THE PRODUCT 1. I was sent Evre's Time To Shine raspberry and almond face scrub. It is 3.4 ounces and I feel that is matches its value well for a teen product. 2. I love well-blended scents especially if it is fruit-based and sweet, and this fits the bill nicely as it is not overpowering at all. 3. I like that there is a lot of granules for mechanical exfoliation. I tried this earlier today and my face felt really nice and cleansed after. I didn't have to use a lot of product since this applies easily. 4. I feel that this is a pretty gentle scrub and I can definitely use it multiple times a week should I want to. OVERALL IMPRESSION: Those who like simple ingredients may enjoy this specially if they have dry sensitive skin because it is gentle.

Face scrub comes inside of a small cardboard box. The box doesn't have any kind of sealant, so it came a bit open and beat up. Thankfully, the bottle itself had the sealant on, so it wasn't tampered with. The ingredients are on the back side of the box. True to the theme of the product there's a lot of raspberry and almond oils in this, alongside the usual skincare products like jojoba oil. I think the jojoba is for the exfoliating part. That's pretty much about it ingredient wise. The quality of the scrub itself is OK. It's not like infamously large granulars lol idk why I guess when I read almond as an ingredient I was thinking of something else, but it's not like that at all. Well they're still large jojoba beads but they aren't like, digging into my skin. It felt more like a moisturizer to me imo. There is some scent to this product as well, the ingredients not only have the oils like I said but includes parfum. It doesn't say clearly what kind of ingredents were used for the aprfum. I personally really love berry and nut scents so I was OK with that. Personally I did not notice any reddness or irrritation when using it but everyone has different skin. For the value not gonna lie it really is high, I'm baffled everytime with the value to quality ratio. This one is OK, it smells good, works fine, but there's nothing really justifying the value

avis.titre: Evre Time To Shine Raspberry & Almond Teen Face Scrub, Keeps my skin clear without over-drying!
avis.texte: This Face Scrub is everything I needed — gentle enough for sensitive skin but effective enough to actually clean. After every Scrub my face feels refreshed and clean without that uncomfortable tight or dry feeling that so many cleansers leave behind. Soft, smooth, and comfortable every single time. As part of the system it's been quite a journey. I started two weeks ago and I won't sugarcoat it — the purge stage was rough. My acne got worse before it got better and there were moments I wanted to quit. But I kept going, cleansing morning and night every single day. And looking at where my skin is today compared to where it was — I am genuinely blown away and so grateful I stuck with it. The difference is incredible. I will keep using this and telling everyone about it.

I really like Evre products, and this face scrub is another good one. The bottles are so cute and fun colors and look great sitting out on my counter. The scrub feels gentle while still giving my skin a nice exfoliation and leaving it feeling smooth and refreshed. It didn’t cause any irritation or leave my skin feeling dry or tight. I also appreciate that the formula is natural, cruelty-free, and palm-free. A nice quality scrub that fits well into a regular skincare routine.

This exfoliating lotion is a bit on the goopy side. Very minimal beads, so I did t feel much “scrubbing” but I can understand this is geared towards acne prone skin. For acne prone skin you wouldn’t want anything to abrasive. The liquid is a bit goopy, so be on the ready to catch it in your hand. There is a mild fragrance for anyone who has a sensitivity to be aware of. It was easy to apply and wash off and it did make my skin feel a little bit softer and smoother but I’ve had better and more noticeable result with other scrubs. At their time of this review is $29, which is pricey in my opinion, it’s just a standard size tube and there are so many products out there that are comparable but for less.

This scrub is marketed as a “gentle exfoliant” but after rubbing it into my face and neck while waiting for the shower to warm (maybe a minute), I ended up with redness around my nose forehead. I have not used any exfoliant or retinols prior to this. The texture actually isn’t heavy on beads, it’s rather creamy with some beads. If you tried scrubs like St Yves, or Trader Joe’s Microdermabrasion Facial Scrub, this is not that texture. More cream + some beads. So i was confused why it caused redness on me, I suspect it’s Benzyl alcohol or linalool and citronellol. It is fragranced, pleasant fragrance, doesn’t linger. I find $29 way overpriced for a basic scrub, this is not a high end skincare with anti-aging goodies, it’s very basic ingredients. I can buy a similar thing at a health food store for half of that price, just as “clean”.

avis.titre: Very gentle and scent is not that strong.
avis.texte: The packaging, both the box and the tube, is very fun. I especially like the colors of it. The facial scrub says it’s raspberry almond but I didn’t not notice any of those scent notes on the scrub. The scent is not strong which I highly prefer. This is definitely a gentle face scrub as it didn’t hurt my face when I applied it on and massaged it in. The beads are not as large but I do feel it exfoliating my face. It didn’t hurt not dry my face out, I did not experience any breakouts, redness or irritations after using this. The price point is a little bit too steep and needs to be reduced.

avis.titre: Would give more than five stars if possible
avis.texte: Not sure which is best about this facial scrub from Evre-how it feels, or, how it smells. Both are lovely. Called Time To Shine. And shine it does. Our in house tween is loving it for after conditioning twice a week. A good facial scrub to remove the sweat and oil as well as exfoliate and restore youthful skin. Of raspberry and almond, which blends beautifully, really adds to the facial scrub experience. Seems specially formulated for young, sensitive skin new to products. Comes in a squeeze bottle that stands on its lud. Meaning the product is always ready at the opening to use. Tried to show how well sealed this arrives. No leaks. Looks like it's from a high end beauty counter or store. Great way to introduce skincare to newbies. Through a great company dedicated to more natural ingredients formulated for younger skin. Very high quality and luxurious.

avis.titre: My daughter likes to use it in the evening followed by moisturizer.
avis.texte: I got this Evre Time To Shine Raspberry & Almond Face Scrub for my 13-year-old daughter. The scrub has this light raspberry scent and it has a soft creamy type texture, and you can feel some fine almond particles as you scrub. My daughter used it and she realized that a small amount is enough to wash the whole face. She started using it once to see how it works for her skin and now that she likes it, she uses it twice a week in the evening after cleansing. I did some research and figured that Evening is the ideal time to use it so the skin can recover overnight and also she avoids using it right before going out in the sun. Nowadays she also uses a gentle moisturizer. The good things is that It has natural ingredients like raspberry/almond, it is cruelty-free and palm-free too. We've noticed that so far it has been gentle on her skin, no redness or dryness of any kind. Overall, a nice scrub for teens (even adults) id looking for something mild/effective for smoother, fresher-looking skin.
